explanation: Not on erdosproblems.com/1182; checked against Nikiforov–Rousseau, 'Ramsey goodness and beyond' (arXiv:math/0703653), Theorem 5.1: 'For n sufficiently large, almost all connected 100-regular graphs of order n are not 3-good.' A connected 100-regular graph on n vertices has 50n edges, so for large n some connected graph with 50n edges is not 3-good and hence F(n) ≤ 50n − 1. The Lean statement ∀ᶠ n, F n < 50·n is this consequence. Correct.
